RATE_LIMIT_LOGIN: Too many login attempts. Please try again later.
RATE_LIMIT_SETUP: Too many setup attempts. Please try again later.
SETUP_ALREADY_COMPLETED: Setup already completed. Use login instead.
SETUP_PANEL_PORT_INVALID: Panel port must be a whole number between 1024 and 65535
CHANGE_PASSWORD_FIELDS_REQUIRED: Current and new password are required
RATE_LIMIT_RESET: Too many reset attempts. Please try again later.
RATE_LIMIT_LOCAL_RECOVERY: Too many local recovery attempts. Please try again later.
RECOVERY_CODE_FIELDS_REQUIRED: A recovery code and a new password are required
LOCAL_RESET_NOT_LOCAL: This recovery action is only available when the panel is opened from the server itself.
LOCAL_RESET_BEHIND_PROXY: This panel is running behind a reverse proxy, so it can't verify a request came from the server itself. Create data/reset-token.txt on the host directly, or use a recovery code instead.
LOCAL_RESET_TOKEN_CREATE_FAILED: Could not create a recovery token on this server.
RESET_PASSWORD_FIELDS_REQUIRED: Token and new password are required
RESET_PASSWORD_TOO_LONG: Password must be 128 characters or fewer
ACCOUNT_CHANGES_NEED_LOGINS: Accounts, roles and sign-in secrets can't be changed while panel logins are off: anyone who can reach the panel could add an admin that keeps working once logins are back on. To turn them on, remove the authEnabled: false setting from the panel's db.json (in its data folder), restart the panel, then sign in.
PASSWORD_TOO_SHORT: Password must be at least 10 characters.
PASSWORD_TOO_LONG_BYTES: Password is too long: use at most 72 plain letters and digits (accented letters, emoji and other scripts count as 2 to 4 each). The panel ignores anything past that.
PASSWORD_TOO_COMMON: This password is one of the most common ones and is easy to guess: choose another.
RESET_TOKEN_NOT_FOUND: No reset token found. Create data/reset-token.txt on the server first.
RESET_TOKEN_TOO_LARGE: Reset token file is invalid (too large). Max 1KB.
RESET_TOKEN_EXPIRED: Reset token file is older than 24 hours. Recreate it on the server.
RESET_TOKEN_TOO_SHORT: Reset token file is invalid. It must contain random hex of at least 32 characters.
RESET_TOKEN_INVALID: That reset token wasn't accepted. Check that data/reset-token.txt on the panel host holds exactly this token, is less than 24 hours old, and is random hex of at least 32 characters from a generator (words, sentences and number sequences are refused). The panel's log says which check failed.
REMOTE_CONFIG_NOT_CONFIGURED: This server is remote. Add its SFTP details and the remote Server folder under Settings > PanelBridge to edit its configuration from here.
REMOTE_BROWSE_NOT_AVAILABLE: Browsing the server filesystem is not available for remote servers.
INI_DUPLICATE_KEY_BLOCKS_STRUCTURED_SAVE: This file has a key duplicated across two config blocks. Saving from the structured editor would permanently discard one copy's value. Use the raw editor tab to fix the duplicate first.
SANDBOX_OPTION_VALUE_INVALID: Option value must be a primitive
SANDBOX_OPTION_FILE_NOT_FOUND: SandboxVars file not found. Start the server once to generate it.
SANDBOX_REPAIR_PATTERN_UNKNOWN: Could not automatically repair this file — the corruption doesn't match a known pattern. Restore from a backup or fix it manually.
SANDBOX_REPAIR_BACKUP_FAILED: Could not back up SandboxVars.lua before repairing it, so nothing was changed: {{reason}}. Free up disk space or fix the backups folder's permissions, or copy the file aside yourself, then try again.
SANDBOX_FILE_UNPARSEABLE: SandboxVars.lua can't be edited safely ({{detail}}). Fix it in the raw editor, run the repair under Checks & Fixes, or restore a backup. Nothing was written.
WORLD_SANDBOX_SNAPSHOT_UNAVAILABLE: The panel can't tell where this server's world save is, so it can't reach its map_sand.bin. Set the server's data folder. For a remote server, the remote Server folder under Settings > PanelBridge must be the game's Server folder.
SPAWNPOINTS_OBJECT_REQUIRED: Spawn points object required (keyed by profession)
RAW_INI_SECRET_UNRESOLVABLE: Could not safely save: the "{{key}}" line's masked value could not be matched back to exactly one live value. Nothing was written.
RAW_INI_SECRET_LINE_REMOVED: The "{{key}}" line was removed, but it holds a live secret that can't be silently dropped. To clear it, write "{{key}}=" explicitly instead of deleting the line, or use the structured editor.
SAVE_AND_RELOAD_RCON_NOT_CONNECTED: RCON not connected. Changes saved but not reloaded.
TEMPLATE_NAME_CONFLICT_LIMIT: Too many templates with similar names
TEMPLATE_APPLY_NOTHING_TO_APPLY: No settings to apply from this template
TEMPLATE_SANDBOX_UNPARSEABLE: This template's saved SandboxVars.lua is not valid Lua ({{detail}}), so nothing was applied. Apply its INI settings only, or save a new template from a working configuration.
BROWSE_ACCESS_DENIED: Access denied: path is outside allowed server directories
BROWSE_NO_PATH: No path provided and server config path not set
SERVER_STATE_UNKNOWN: Can't verify whether the server is actually stopped — the process-detection scan itself failed, not the server. Check the panel's log for the error. If this keeps happening, something on this host (antivirus, a full disk, or a missing system tool) may be blocking detection.
SERVER_RUNNING: Stop the server before editing configuration.
ROLE_LOCKOUT_LAST_MANAGER: This change would leave no user able to {{action}}
ROLE_SELF_CAPABILITY_LOSS_CONFIRM: This would remove your own ability to {{action}}
ROLE_HAS_MEMBERS: {{count}} user(s) still hold this role. Pass reassignTo to move them to another role first.
SERVER_RUNNING_LEGACY: Stop the server before deleting chunks. Running servers hold save files open and will overwrite your changes on shutdown.
DOCKER_UPDATER_NOT_CONFIGURED_LEGACY: Docker update controller is not configured
APPLY_IN_PROGRESS_LEGACY: An update apply is already in progress.
CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED_LEGACY: Confirm the Docker update before recreating the all-in-one container.
SAVE_FAILED_LEGACY: The world could not be saved ({{reason}}), so the server was left running and the update was not applied. If the server is stuck, use Force stop on the Dashboard, then apply the update again. Force stop tries one quick save, then stops the server either way, so anything since the last successful save can be lost.
STOP_FAILED_LEGACY: The world was saved, but the server could not be shut down ({{reason}}). It is still running, so the update was not applied. Use Force stop on the Dashboard to stop it, then apply the update again.
INVALID_BUNDLE_LEGACY: The staged update bundle is invalid, corrupted, or doesn't match this installation.
VERSION_MISMATCH_LEGACY: Frontend and backend build metadata do not match.
AV_QUARANTINE_LEGACY: The staged update file is missing or was altered after staging, likely quarantined by antivirus or Controlled Folder Access.
HASH_UNVERIFIABLE_LEGACY: Could not verify the staged update files' integrity.
FRONTEND_SWAP_FAILED_LEGACY: Could not activate the staged frontend files.
BINARY_SWAP_FAILED_LEGACY: Could not activate the staged update binary.
ROLLBACK_FAILED_LEGACY: The update failed and the automatic rollback did not fully complete. The panel may need manual recovery.
SERVER_RUNNING_RCON_UNAVAILABLE: Stop the Project Zomboid server before applying a Docker update. RCON is not connected, so the panel can't save the world and stop it for you. If the server is stuck, use Force stop on the Dashboard: while RCON is disconnected it can't save first and stops the server straight away, so anything since the last successful save will be lost.
SERVER_STOP_NOT_CONFIRMED: The world was saved and a shutdown was sent, but the server process still hasn't exited, so the update was not applied. Wait a little and try again. If it doesn't exit, use Force stop on the Dashboard, then apply the update again; anything since that save can be lost.
CONTAINER_NOT_MAPPED: Container is not mapped to this server
CONTAINER_NOT_MANAGED: Container is not managed by this panel
DOCKER_ACTION_RCON_CONNECT_FAILED: RCON connection failed; container was not changed
RCON_CONNECT_FAILED: Could not connect to RCON. Is the server running and RCON enabled?
RCON_CONNECT_UNREACHABLE: Could not connect to RCON. Is the server running and RCON enabled?
RCON_CONNECT_AUTH_FAILED: Connected to the server, but authentication failed. Check the RCON password in server settings.
RCON_EXECUTE_DISCONNECTED: RCON disconnected while running a command.
BACKUP_REMOTE_NOT_AVAILABLE: Backups are not available for remote servers. The server filesystem is not accessible from this panel.
BACKUP_SAVES_FOLDER_NOT_FOUND: This server's world folder was not found, so there is nothing to back up. Start the server once so it creates its world, or check the server name and data folder in the server settings.
BACKUP_INSUFFICIENT_DISK_SPACE: Not enough free disk space for this backup: about {{needed}} is needed and {{free}} is free. Free up disk space or lower "Maximum Backups to Keep", then try again.
BACKUP_RESTORE_REMOTE_NOT_AVAILABLE: Backup restore is not available for remote servers. The server filesystem is not accessible from this panel.
BACKUP_RESTORE_SERVER_RUNNING: Server must be stopped before restoring a backup. Please stop the server first.
BACKUP_INVALID_DAYS_PARAMETER: Invalid days parameter. Must be a whole number >= 1
BACKUP_ACTIVE_SERVER_CHANGED: The active server changed since these settings were loaded. Reload backup settings before saving.
BACKUP_SERVER_IDS_INVALID: The servers to back up must be a list of up to {{max}} servers
BACKUP_SCHEDULE_TOO_FREQUENT: Backups cannot run more often than every 5 minutes
BACKUP_UPLOAD_REMOTE_NOT_AVAILABLE: Backup upload is not available for remote servers.
BACKUP_UPLOAD_NO_FILE: No file uploaded. Send the zip body with Content-Type: application/zip.
BACKUP_UPLOAD_INVALID_ZIP_SIGNATURE: File does not look like a valid .zip archive.
BACKUP_UPLOAD_NAME_CONFLICT: A backup named "{{name}}" already exists. Delete it first or rename the upload.
BACKUP_SNAPSHOT_TOO_LARGE: This backup's server snapshot is larger than 1 MB, so it was not opened.
BACKUP_ARCHIVE_SIZE_MISMATCH: The backup archive holds more data than it records, so it is damaged or was tampered with. The restore stopped and your current world was not changed.
BACKUPS_FOLDER_UNAVAILABLE: Backups folder not available. Configure the server first.
USER_SELF_DELETE_REFUSED: You cannot delete your own account. Ask another administrator to do it instead.
USER_SELF_ROLE_CHANGE_REFUSED: You cannot change your own role. Ask another administrator to do it instead.
ROLE_GRANT_EXCEEDS_CALLER_CAPABILITIES: Cannot assign a role that grants {{detail}} without holding it yourself.
SERVER_START_REMOTE_REFUSED: Cannot start a remote server. Remote servers are managed externally — use RCON to interact.
SERVER_START_SCRIPT_MISSING: The startup script {{script}} is missing from this server's install folder. The panel writes it from the server's settings before every start but couldn't this time — check that the install folder exists and that the panel can write to it (the panel log has the exact reason), then start again. The panel won't fall back to {{fallback}}: that starts Project Zomboid's default "servertest" world instead of this server, and can stop at a prompt for a new admin password.
SERVER_RESTART_SCRIPT_MISSING: Restart called off before stopping the server — it is still running. The startup script {{script}} is missing from this server's install folder and the panel can't write it there, so it couldn't have started the server again. Check that the install folder exists and that the panel can write to it (the panel log has the exact reason), then restart again. The panel won't fall back to {{fallback}}: that starts Project Zomboid's default "servertest" world instead of this server, and can stop at a prompt for a new admin password.
SERVER_START_GAME_PORT_IN_USE: UDP port {{port}} is already used by {{name}}, which is running. Stop that server, or give this one a different game port, then start again.
SERVER_START_STATE_UNKNOWN: The panel can't tell whether the server is running on this PC: process detection keeps failing, and nothing else shows it stopped. Start it anyway only if you're sure it isn't running.
SERVER_LAUNCH_TARGET_REFUSED: The panel won't launch {{program}} for this server: it only launches a script or program inside the server's own install folder, never one elsewhere on this computer or a system command interpreter. An admin can fix this in Servers › Edit Server: point Custom Start Command (or an Install Path that names a launcher script) at a script inside the server's install folder, or clear Custom Start Command so the panel writes and runs its own launch script.
SERVER_RESTART_LAUNCH_TARGET_REFUSED: Restart called off before stopping the server — it is still running. The panel wouldn't launch {{program}} to start it again: it only launches a script or program inside the server's own install folder, never one elsewhere on this computer or a system command interpreter. An admin can fix this in Servers › Edit Server, then restart again.
SERVER_LAUNCH_FOLDER_REFUSED: The panel won't start this server from its install folder: it is inside a Steam Workshop download folder or on a network share, where whoever publishes the Workshop item or runs the share decides what runs on this computer. An admin can set the game's own install folder in Servers › Edit Server.
SERVER_LAUNCH_TARGET_ADMIN_ONLY: Changing a server's start command or launcher script requires the files.manage permission, which this role doesn't have: whatever it names runs on this computer when the server starts. Ask an admin to make this change.
SERVER_RCON_CHANGE_REQUIRES_CONFIGURE: Changing a server's RCON host, port or password requires the server.configure permission, which this role doesn't have. Ask an admin to make this change.
SERVER_RCON_PASSWORD_REQUIRED_FOR_NEW_TA: Enter the RCON password again to change the RCON host or port: the saved password is only sent to the host and port it was saved for.
SERVER_RCON_RECONNECT_FAILED: RCON could not reconnect; verify the updated connection settings.
SERVER_RCON_RELOAD_FAILED: RCON failed to reload; reconnect before relying on the updated connection settings.
SERVER_RESTART_RCON_UNAVAILABLE: RCON isn't answering ({{reason}}), so the panel couldn't save the world first: the restart was cancelled and the server was left running. If the server is stuck, use Force stop on the Dashboard, then start it again. Force stop saves first only if RCON answers, so anything since the last successful save can be lost.
SERVER_RESTART_SAVE_FAILED: The world could not be saved ({{reason}}), so the restart was cancelled and the server was left running. If the server is stuck, use Force stop on the Dashboard, then start it again. Force stop tries one quick save, then stops the server either way, so anything since the last successful save can be lost.
SERVER_RESTART_STOP_UNCONFIRMED: The world was saved and the panel asked the server to shut down, but process detection kept failing, so the panel couldn't confirm the old server exited. It did not start a new one, so two copies never run at once. Once the Dashboard shows the server stopped, start it again; if detection keeps failing, check the panel's log.
SERVER_FORCE_STOP_REMOTE_REFUSED: Cannot force-stop a remote server. The process is not managed by this panel.
SERVER_RESTART_REMOTE_REFUSED: Cannot restart a remote server. The process is not managed by this panel.
SERVER_STOP_RCON_NOT_CONNECTED: RCON is not connected, so the panel can't save the world and stop the server gracefully. If the server is stuck, use Force stop: while RCON is disconnected it can't save first and stops the server straight away, so anything since the last successful save will be lost.
SERVER_STOP_RCON_NOT_CONNECTED_REMOTE: RCON is not connected, so the panel can't save the world and stop this remote server. The panel doesn't manage a remote server's process and can't force-stop it: if the server is stuck, restart it on the machine that hosts it.
SERVER_STOP_SAVE_FAILED: The world could not be saved ({{reason}}), so the server was left running. If the server is stuck, use Force stop: it tries one quick save, then stops the server either way, so anything since the last successful save can be lost.
SERVER_STOP_SAVE_FAILED_REMOTE: The world could not be saved ({{reason}}), so the server was left running. The panel doesn't manage a remote server's process and can't force-stop it: if the server is stuck, restart it on the machine that hosts it. Anything since the last successful save can be lost.
SERVER_STOP_CONTAINER_STOP_FAILED: The world was saved, but the container could not be stopped: {{reason}}
SERVER_MESSAGE_TOO_LONG: Message must be a string under 1000 characters
STEAMCMD_FOLDER_REFUSED: SteamCMD can't be used from this folder: it is inside a Steam Workshop download folder or on a network share, whose files anyone could supply. Choose the folder SteamCMD is installed in on this computer.
INSTALL_MISSING_FIELDS: Missing required fields: steamcmdPath, installPath, serverName
SERVER_NAME_FORMAT_INVALID: Invalid server name. Use only letters, numbers, underscores, hyphens, and spaces (max 64 chars)
ZOMBOID_DATA_PATH_UNSUPPORTED_CHARACTERS: The Zomboid data folder's path can't contain a double quote, because the server's start script can't carry it safely. Rename the folder or choose another.
ADMIN_PASSWORD_UNSUPPORTED_CHARACTERS: The admin password can't contain a double quote or a control character (such as a line break), because the server's start script can't carry it safely. Choose a different password.
INVALID_SERVER_PORT: Game port must be a whole number between 1024 and 65534.
INVALID_RCON_PORT: RCON port must be a whole number between 1024 and 65535.
INVALID_MIN_MEMORY: Minimum memory must be a whole number between 1 and 64 (GB).
INVALID_MAX_MEMORY: Maximum memory must be a whole number between 1 and 128 (GB).
MEMORY_MIN_EXCEEDS_MAX: Minimum memory ({{min}} GB) can't be higher than maximum memory ({{max}} GB).
SERVER_ALREADY_EXISTS: A server called {{name}} that uses this data folder is already on the list.
WRITABLE_PATH_ERROR: {{label}} is not writable: {{path}}. Choose a folder writable by the panel process.
WRITABLE_PATH_INSTALL_BAREMETAL: Installation path is not writable: {{path}}. The user running the panel does not own this folder or lacks write permission to it -- fix it with chown/chmod, or choose a folder the panel can already write to.
WRITABLE_PATH_INSTALL_CONTAINER: Installation path is not writable: {{path}}. Set PUID/PGID in your .env file to match the owner of this bind-mounted host folder (see docker-compose.yml's Quick Start), then recreate the container.
WRITABLE_PATH_DATA_BAREMETAL: Zomboid data folder is not writable: {{path}}. The user running the panel does not own this folder or lacks write permission to it -- fix it with chown/chmod, or choose a folder the panel can already write to.
WRITABLE_PATH_DATA_CONTAINER: Zomboid data folder is not writable: {{path}}. Set PUID/PGID in your .env file to match the owner of this bind-mounted host folder (see docker-compose.yml's Quick Start), then recreate the container.
CONTAINER_PATH_NOT_PERSISTENT: {{path}} is inside the container's own filesystem, not on a volume, so everything put there is erased when the container is recreated (every panel update does that). Use a folder on a Docker volume or bind mount.
CONTAINER_PATH_NOT_PERSISTENT_AIO: {{path}} is inside the container's own filesystem, not on a volume, so everything put there is erased when the container is recreated (every panel update does that). Use a folder inside {{root}}.
CONTAINER_PATH_NOT_PERSISTENT_AIO_NO_VOL: {{path}} is inside the container's own filesystem, not on a volume, so everything put there is erased when the container is recreated (every panel update does that). This all-in-one install has no volume for extra servers yet: run the installer (bootstrap.sh) again to add it, then use a folder inside {{root}}.
OTHER_SERVERS_RUNNING: Stop {{names}} before applying a Docker update. Recreating the container stops every Project Zomboid server in it, and only the active server is saved and stopped for you.
STEAM_OPERATION_IN_PROGRESS_PATH: A Steam operation is already in progress for this path. Please wait for it to complete.
QUICK_SETUP_SERVER_FILES_NOT_FOUND: Server files not found. Make sure the path contains Project Zomboid dedicated server files.
RCON_PASSWORD_UNSUPPORTED_CHARS: The RCON password cannot contain "=" or a line break, or end with a space or tab. Project Zomboid reads a server.ini value only up to the first "=" and trims blanks off the end of the line, so the game would end up with a different password than the panel.
SERVER_CONFIG_PATH_NOT_SET: Server config path not set. Please run installation first.
SERVER_CONFIG_FILE_NOT_FOUND: Server config not found at {{path}}. Start the server once first to generate the config file.
STEAM_OPERATION_IN_PROGRESS_SERVER: A Steam operation is already in progress for this server. Please wait for it to complete.
STEAMCMD_DOWNLOAD_ALREADY_IN_PROGRESS: A SteamCMD download is already in progress.
DELETE_FILES_NOT_PZ_INSTALL: This does not appear to be a Project Zomboid server installation. Refusing to delete for safety.
DELETE_FILES_DATA_PATH_NESTED: Refusing to delete: this server's Zomboid data folder is inside the folder you're about to delete, so this would also destroy the world save. Move the data path outside the install folder in Settings, or back it up yourself first.
DELETE_FILES_NOT_CONFIGURED_SERVER: This path doesn't match a server the panel has on record. Refusing to delete for safety.
DELETE_FILES_CONFIRM_REQUIRED: Deleting these files requires confirm: true
DELETE_FILES_FOLDER_SHARED: Also using this game folder: {{names}}. Deleting it removes their game files too. Confirm to delete it anyway.
INSTALL_FOLDER_SHARED_SERVER_RUNNING: "{{name}}" uses the same game folder and is running. Stop it first.
DIRECTORY_READ_FAILED_WINDOWS: Cannot read {{path}} ({{code}}). Run the panel as an account that can read this folder.
DIRECTORY_READ_FAILED_POSIX: Cannot read {{path}} ({{code}}). The panel service account needs read and execute permission on this folder and every parent folder.
BROWSE_FOLDER_NO_DIALOG_AVAILABLE: No folder browser available. Install zenity or kdialog, or enter the path manually.
WIPE_TARGETS_REQUIRED: targets must be a non-empty array of: map, players, world, accounts
WIPE_IN_PROGRESS: A wipe operation is already in progress. Please wait.
WIPE_SERVER_RUNNING: Server must be stopped before wiping. Stop the server first.
WIPE_BACKUP_FAILED: Wipe aborted: could not create a backup first. Nothing was deleted.
WIPE_PARTIAL_FAILURE: Wipe failed partway through ({{reason}}). Some of the selected targets may be only partially deleted -- check the results for what completed before the failure.
CHUNKS_SAVE_PATH_CAPABILITY_REQUIRED: Repointing the server's data path also requires server.configure.
DELETE_CHUNKS_FIELDS_REQUIRED: Save name and chunks array required
DELETE_CHUNKS_TOO_MANY: Too many chunks ({{count}}). Maximum is 100,000 per request — split into smaller batches.
SQLITE_ENGINE_UNAVAILABLE: The panel's SQLite engine could not start, so vehicles.db can't be cleaned. No files were deleted. Update or reinstall the panel, then restart it.
DELETE_CHUNKS_INVALID_X: Invalid chunk x coordinate — must be an integer
DELETE_CHUNKS_INVALID_Y: Invalid chunk y coordinate — must be an integer
CHUNKS_STALE_SERVER_SCAN: The active server changed since these chunks were scanned. Refresh the save list and re-select before deleting.
DELETE_CHUNKS_ALL_FAILED: Every selected chunk failed to delete: {{reason}}
DELETE_REGION_FIELDS_REQUIRED: Save name and region bounds required
DELETE_REGION_BOUNDS_NOT_FINITE: Region bounds must be finite numbers
DELETE_REGION_BOUNDS_INVERTED: Region bounds inverted (minX > maxX or minY > maxY)
DELETE_REGION_TOO_LARGE: Region too large ({{count}} chunks). Maximum is 100,000 at a time.
BROWSE_CHUNKS_DATA_PATH_NOT_SET: No Zomboid data path configured to browse
BROWSE_CHUNKS_ACCESS_DENIED: Access denied: path is outside the server's save directory
MODS_ADD_ADVANCED_SELECTION_REQUIRED: Either selectedModIds or includeAllModIds is required
MODS_ADD_ALL_DEPS_TOO_MANY: Too many dependencies in one request (max 200)
MODS_ADD_TO_INI_CONFIG_PATH_NOT_SET: Server config path not set. Please configure the server first in Settings.
MODS_BATCH_REMOVE_INI_NOT_ACCESSIBLE: Server config file was not found or not accessible — no mods were removed.
MODS_BATCH_TOGGLE_ENABLED_BOOLEAN_REQUIR: Each change must have an enabled boolean
MODS_BATCH_TOGGLE_MODID_STRING_REQUIRED: Each change must have a modId string
MODS_BATCH_TOGGLE_WORKSHOP_ID_IN_MODS: Refusing to add {{count}} workshop-ID-shaped entries to Mods= (those belong in WorkshopItems=).
MODS_CHECK_INTERVAL_INVALID: Interval must be a whole number of minutes from 60000ms to 7200000ms
MODS_CHECK_UPDATES_ACF_NOT_FOUND: No Workshop update data found for this install. This is expected for a non-Steam install, or a Steam install that hasn't downloaded a Workshop mod yet — you can still manage mods manually.
MODS_CONFIG_FILE_NOT_FOUND_GUIDANCE: Server config file not found. Start the server once first to generate the config file.
MODS_CONFIG_PATH_NOT_SET_GUIDANCE: Server config path not set. Please configure the server first.
MODS_CONFLICTS_DIFF_FILES_NOT_FOUND: Could not find both mod files on disk — they may have been removed or updated since the last scan
MODS_CONFLICTS_DIFF_MOD_ID_INVALID: Could not identify one of the mods — try rescanning
MODS_CONFLICTS_DIFF_PARAMS_REQUIRED: Could not load file comparison — missing file or mod information
MODS_CONFLICTS_DIFF_PATH_INVALID: The file path looks invalid — try rescanning conflicts
MODS_CONFLICT_SCAN_ALREADY_RUNNING: A conflict scan is already running. Please wait.
MODS_DISCOVER_WORKSHOP_ID_OR_URL_REQUIRE: Workshop ID or URL is required
MODS_EXTENSION_COOKIES_CONTROL_CHARS: Cookie values contain forbidden control characters
MODS_EXTENSION_COOKIES_REQUIRED: Both sessionid and steamLoginSecure are required
MODS_EXTENSION_FILES_MISSING: Browser extension files are missing from this panel install. Download zomboid-panel-extension.zip from the GitHub release instead.
MODS_GROUP_IMPORT_INVALID: This file is not a valid mod group export.
MODS_GROUP_LIMIT_REACHED: You can keep at most {{max}} mod groups. Delete one first.
MODS_HEALTH_FIX_NOT_OFFERED: This fix is not offered for that problem.
MODS_HEALTH_ISSUE_GONE: This problem is gone or has changed. Check again.
MODS_AUTOFIX_SNAPSHOT_NOT_FOUND: There is nothing to undo any more: the panel restarted or another server is active.
MODS_IGNORED_PAIR_INVALID_IDS: modIdA and modIdB are required and must be valid mod IDs
MODS_IGNORED_PAIR_NOT_FOUND: Pair not found in ignore list
MODS_IGNORE_ENTRY_NOT_FOUND: Mod not found in ignore list
MODS_IMPORT_COLLECTION_PRIVATE: Collection not found or is private
MODS_IMPORT_COLLECTION_TIMEOUT: Steam collection lookup timed out. Please try again.
MODS_IMPORT_COLLECTION_URL_REQUIRED: Collection URL or ID is required
MODS_INI_NOT_ACCESSIBLE: Server config file was not found or not accessible
MODS_INVALID_BROWSER: Invalid browser. Must be one of: {{browsers}}
MODS_NOTE_INVALID: A mod note must be plain text.
MODS_NOTE_LIMIT_REACHED: You can keep at most {{max}} mod notes. Delete one first.
MODS_NOTE_TOO_LONG: A mod note can be at most {{max}} characters.
MODS_ORDER_RULE_CYCLE: This rule would make a loop with other rules or required mods ({{count}} mods).
MODS_ORDER_RULE_LIMIT: You can keep at most {{max}} order rules. Delete one first.
MODS_PLAN_INVALID: The load order request is invalid: {{field}}
MODS_PURGE_INI_NOT_ACCESSIBLE: Server config file was not found or not accessible — the mod was not removed from the server.
MODS_RESOLVE_DEPS_TOO_MANY: Too many dependencies in one request (max 200)
MODS_RESTART_CHECK_INTERVAL_INVALID: checkInterval must be a whole number of minutes from 60000ms to 7200000ms
MODS_RESTART_MAX_DELAY_MINUTES_INVALID: maxDelayMinutes must be a whole number from 5 to 120
MODS_RESTART_WARNING_MINUTES_INVALID: warningMinutes must be a whole number from 0 to 30
MODS_SAVE_ORDER_MODID_STRING_REQUIRED: Each mod ID must be a string (max 200 chars)
MODS_SEARCH_QUERY_TOO_SHORT: Query must be at least 2 characters
MODS_SERVER_INSTALL_PATH_NOT_SET: Server install path not set — configure it in Settings
MODS_START_ACF_PATH_NOT_SET: Mod checker could not start. Configure a valid Workshop ACF path first.
MODS_TOGGLE_WORKSHOP_ID_IN_MODID: That looks like a Steam Workshop ID, not a mod ID. Workshop IDs (numeric) belong in WorkshopItems=, not Mods=.
MODS_WORKSHOP_IDS_ARRAY_REQUIRED: workshopIds must be a non-empty array
BRIDGE_NOT_RUNNING: Bridge not running. Start it first.
BRIDGE_XY_COORDS_REQUIRED: x and y coordinates are required
PANELBRIDGE_AUTO_CONFIGURE_NO_ACTIVE_SER: No active server configured. Please configure a server first.
PANELBRIDGE_PATH_NOT_DETERMINED: Could not determine bridge path for server "{{serverName}}". Make sure server installPath is set.
PANELBRIDGE_PATH_PROTECTED_SYSTEM_DIR: Path targets a protected system directory
PANELBRIDGE_COMMAND_REMOTE_TRANSPORT_UNA: PanelBridge requires a configured mapped drive or a running SFTP bridge transport for remote servers.
PANELBRIDGE_ACTION_CAPABILITY_REQUIRED: This action requires players.moderate in addition to bridge.command.
PANELBRIDGE_AIRDROP_ITEMS_ARRAY_INVALID: items must be an array with at most 50 entries
PANELBRIDGE_AIRDROP_ITEM_INVALID: Each item must be an object with itemType
PANELBRIDGE_TEMPERATURE_VALUE_INVALID: value must be a number -50 to 50
PANELBRIDGE_INSTALL_REMOTE_NOT_AVAILABLE: Automatic PanelBridge installation is unavailable for remote servers. Copy PanelBridge.lua to the remote server's Lua folder using SFTP or the hosting provider's file manager.
PANELBRIDGE_INSTALL_CANNOT_AUTO_INSTALL: Automatic PanelBridge installation is unavailable. Configure an existing local server install folder with write permission, or use the manual install path.
PANELBRIDGE_CHARACTER_DATA_NOT_OBJECT: Character data must be an object
PANELBRIDGE_CHARACTER_DATA_NO_VALID_SECT: Character data must contain at least one of: {{sections}}
PANELBRIDGE_CHARACTER_PERK_INVALID: Each skill in the character data must have a whole-number level from 0 to 10.
PANELBRIDGE_ADMIN_CHAT_UNAVAILABLE: Neither PanelBridge nor RCON available for admin chat
PANELBRIDGE_CHAT_UNAVAILABLE: Neither PanelBridge nor RCON available for chat
PANELBRIDGE_SCAN_ITEMS_NOT_RUNNING: Bridge not running — server must be online to scan items
PANELBRIDGE_SCAN_VEHICLES_NOT_RUNNING: Bridge not running — server must be online to scan vehicles
SFTP_CHROOTED_ACCOUNT: {{detail}} Fix: This SFTP account appears to be chrooted. Remove the /home prefix and enter the path exactly as shown in the SFTP client, for example /server-data/lua/panelbridge/MyServer.
SFTP_AUTH_FAILED: {{detail}} Fix: Verify the SFTP username and password, then confirm the account can log in over port 22.
SFTP_PERMISSION_DENIED: {{detail}} Fix: Give the SFTP account read and write permission for the remote bridge folder and its parent directory.
SFTP_REMOTE_PATH_MISSING: {{detail}} Fix: Verify the remote bridge folder is the VPS path to Lua/panelbridge/MyServer. The panel will create its inbox and outbox folders after the parent path is correct.
SFTP_PATH_OCCUPIED: {{detail}} Fix: Remove or rename the directory occupying that bridge file path, then run Verify and prepare SFTP again.
SFTP_HOST_KEY_MISMATCH: {{detail}} Fix: This server's SSH host key is not the one the panel saved the first time it connected. If you rebuilt or reinstalled the server, confirm the new key with your host, then use “Trust new host key” in Settings › PanelBridge › SFTP. If nothing changed on the server, do not trust it: someone may be intercepting the connection.
SFTP_HOST_KEY_NOT_PRESENTED: This server is no longer presenting that host key, so nothing was trusted. Connect to it again, then compare the key the panel shows before trusting it.
SFTP_PASSWORD_REQUIRED: Enter the SFTP password for this host. The saved password is only used with the saved host, port and username.
SFTP_UNREACHABLE: {{detail}} Fix: Check the SFTP host, port, firewall, and that the hosting provider allows SFTP from this panel computer.
SFTP_UNKNOWN: {{detail}} Fix: Run Verify and prepare SFTP again. If it still fails, download a support bundle and include sftp-diagnostics.json.
UNEXPECTED_SERVER_ERROR: {{detail}} This wasn't expected — if it keeps happening, download a support bundle so it can be investigated.
OIDC_CREDENTIALS_REJECTED: The provider rejected the client ID or client secret. Double-check both against the identity provider's admin screen.
OIDC_TEST_UNDETERMINED: The issuer is reachable, but this didn't confirm whether the credentials are valid: {{reason}}. Try signing in for a definitive answer.
OIDC_ISSUER_MISMATCH: The discovery document at this URL names a different issuer ({{issuer}}). Enter the provider's issuer URL itself, or the discovery URL that issuer publishes.
OIDC_PROVIDER_FIELDS_ADMIN_ONLY: Only an administrator can change the issuer URL, client ID, client secret, redirect URI or plain-HTTP setting. You can still change the display name and scope.
OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET_REQUIRED: Enter the client secret for this provider. The saved secret is only used with the saved issuer URL and client ID.
PLAYERS_LAST_ADMIN_ACCESS_LEVEL_CONFIRM: {{username}} is the only account with the admin access level. Removing it will leave nobody with full admin commands in-game until it is granted again.
PLAYERS_STAFF_ACCESS_LEVEL_NEEDS_RCON: Only a role with Run RCON commands (rcon.execute) can grant a staff access level such as admin, moderator or gm, or change the level of an account that has one: those levels run server console commands in game.
PLAYERS_TELEPORT_BRIDGE_OFFLINE: PanelBridge is not running — cannot teleport a player to coordinates without it
PLAYERS_ADD_ITEM_TARGET_REQUIRED: A player must be selected to give items
PLAYERS_ADD_XP_FIELDS_REQUIRED: Username, perk, and amount are required
PLAYERS_NOTE_INVALID_TAGS: Tags must be text, at most 50 characters each and 20 per note
PLAYERS_NOTES_FULL: Player notes are full ({{max}} notes or 5 million characters in all). Delete notes you no longer need, then try again.
SCHEDULER_REQUEST_BODY_INVALID: Request body must be an object
SCHEDULER_TASK_FIELDS_REQUIRED: Name, cron expression, and command are required
SCHEDULER_INVALID_CRON_EXPRESSION: Invalid cron expression. Use the format: minute hour day month weekday (e.g. "0 */6 * * *" for every 6 hours)
SCHEDULER_CRON_SECONDS_UNSUPPORTED: The panel does not support seconds-precision schedules. Use exactly 5 fields: minute hour day month weekday
SCHEDULER_CRON_TOO_FREQUENT: Tasks cannot run more frequently than every 5 minutes
SCHEDULER_INVALID_ENABLED_VALUE: The enabled field must be a boolean or 0/1
SCHEDULER_RESTART_REMOTE_NOT_SUPPORTED: Cannot restart a remote server. The process is not managed by this panel
SCHEDULER_INVALID_TIMEZONE: "{{tz}}" is not a valid timezone name (e.g. "America/New_York", "UTC")
CONFIG_APP_SETTINGS_CAPABILITY_REQUIRED: Cannot change {{detail}} without holding that capability yourself.
CONFIG_INVALID_SERVER_NAME: Server name may only contain letters, numbers, spaces, underscores and hyphens (and can't start or end with a space)
CONFIG_INVALID_MOD_CHECK_INTERVAL: The mod-check interval must be a whole number of minutes from 1 to 120
CONFIG_INVALID_LAN_IP: The LAN IP address must be a valid IPv4 address or left empty
CONFIG_HTTPS_PATH_NOT_FOUND: {{field}} does not point to a file that exists: {{value}}
CONFIG_HTTPS_PATH_NOT_A_FILE: {{field}} must be a file, not a directory: {{value}}
CONFIG_HTTPS_PATH_NOT_READABLE: {{field}} exists but is not readable by the panel: {{value}}
CONFIG_HTTPS_PORT_MATCHES_PANEL_PORT: The HTTPS port cannot be the same as the panel's HTTP port ({{panelPort}})
CONFIG_PANEL_PORT_MATCHES_HTTPS_PORT: The panel port cannot be the same as the panel's HTTPS port ({{httpsPort}})
CONFIG_CHAT_PRESETS_NOT_ARRAY: Chat presets must be a list
CONFIG_CHAT_PRESETS_TOO_MANY: Chat presets supports up to 50 entries
CONFIG_CHAT_PRESETS_INVALID_ENTRY: Chat preset entries must be text up to 500 characters
CONFIG_AUTO_START_SERVER_IDS_INVALID: The servers to auto-start must be a list of up to {{max}} servers
CONFIG_RESTART_ON_CRASH_SERVER_IDS_INVAL: The servers to restart when they go down must be a list of up to {{max}} servers
SERVERS_ACTION_ACTIVE_SERVER: {{name}} is the active server: use the Dashboard's own Start, Stop and Restart.
SERVERS_ACTION_REMOTE_REFUSED: {{name}} runs on another machine, so the panel doesn't start, stop or restart it from the list of servers. Show it on the Dashboard to stop it over RCON.
SERVERS_ACTION_STATE_UNKNOWN: The panel can't tell whether {{name}} is running, so it did nothing. Try again in a moment.
SERVERS_START_ADMIN_PASSWORD_MISSING: {{name}} has never started before and has no admin password set, so Project Zomboid would stop at a console prompt for one that the panel can't answer. Set an admin password for it in My Servers, then start it again.
SERVERS_STOP_RCON_UNAVAILABLE: RCON on {{name}} doesn't answer, so the panel can't save its world and stop it. If it is stuck, show it on the Dashboard and use Force stop there.
SERVERS_STOP_SAVE_FAILED: {{name}}'s world could not be saved ({{reason}}), so it was left running. If it is stuck, show it on the Dashboard and use Force stop there.
CONFIG_CORS_RELOAD_UNAVAILABLE: CORS configuration reload is not available
DISCORD_TOKEN_AND_GUILD_REQUIRED: Token and Guild ID are required
DISCORD_INVALID_GUILD_ID: Invalid Guild ID format (must be a Discord Snowflake)
DISCORD_INVALID_CHAT_RELAY_CHANNEL_ID: Invalid Chat Relay Channel ID format
DISCORD_TEST_TOKEN_INVALID_INPUT: Token must be a non-empty string (max 200 chars)
DISCORD_TEST_RATE_LIMITED: Discord is rate-limiting this request. Wait a moment and try again.
DISCORD_TEST_API_UNAVAILABLE: Discord's API is unavailable right now (HTTP {{status}}). This isn't your token -- try again shortly.
DISCORD_TEST_MESSAGE_REJECTED: Discord rejected the message. Check the notification channel ID and that the bot can post there.
DISCORD_PERMISSIONS_CAPABILITY_REQUIRED: Cannot change the Discord tier for {{detail}} without holding that capability yourself.
SIM_TEMPLATE_SERVER_NO_CONFIG_PATH: Server has no configured config path
SIM_TEMPLATE_APPLY_SERVER_RUNNING: Stop the server before applying a template
SIM_TEMPLATE_APPLY_REMOTE_UNSUPPORTED: Applying templates to remote servers is not supported yet.
SIM_TEMPLATE_APPLY_INI_MISSING: Server INI file not found — start the server once to generate it, or apply Sandbox settings only.
WRITABILITY_STILL_BLOCKED: The file is still not writable after clearing the read-only attribute — this looks like an ownership or permissions issue
PANELBRIDGE_DELIVERY_NOT_ACTIVE_SERVER: The active server changed. Reload this page and try again.
PANELBRIDGE_DELIVERY_STALE: PanelBridge delivery for this server changed since you opened this page (now: {{current}}). Review the steps again.
PANELBRIDGE_DELIVERY_UNAVAILABLE: This change isn't available for this server right now ({{reason}}).
PANELBRIDGE_DELIVERY_INI_WRITE_FAILED: Couldn't update {{fileName}}. The panel put back what it had already changed.
PANELBRIDGE_DELIVERY_FILE_ARCHIVE_FAILED: Couldn't move {{fileName}} out of the game folder. Check its permissions and try again. The panel put back what it had already changed.
PANELBRIDGE_DELIVERY_INSTALL_FAILED: Couldn't copy PanelBridge.lua into the game folder. Nothing was changed.
PANELBRIDGE_DELIVERY_WORKSHOP_ACTIVE: {{serverName}} gets PanelBridge from the Steam Workshop, so the panel doesn't copy PanelBridge.lua into its game folder. Switch it back to panel-installed in Settings › PanelBridge first.
SERVER_NOSTEAM_CONFLICTS_WITH_WORKSHOP_B: This server gets PanelBridge from the Steam Workshop, which needs Steam. Switch PanelBridge to panel-installed in Settings › PanelBridge before turning on Launch without Steam.
SERVER_NOSTEAM_SIBLING_CONFLICTS_WITH_WO: This server gets PanelBridge from the Steam Workshop, which needs Steam, and every server sharing a game folder gets it the same way. These servers in that folder launch without Steam: {{names}}. First switch this server's PanelBridge to panel-installed in Settings › PanelBridge, or have them launch with Steam.
PANELBRIDGE_INSTALL_FAILED: Couldn't copy PanelBridge.lua into the game folder. Check the panel log for the reason.
PANELBRIDGE_INSTALL_STILL_RUNNING: Installing PanelBridge is taking longer than usual and continues in the background. Check again in a moment.
FM_AUTH_DISABLED: The file manager only works while panel logins are on. To turn them on, remove the authEnabled: false setting from the panel's db.json (in its data folder), restart the panel, then sign in.
FM_TOKEN_IN_URL: This request carried a sign-in token in its address, which the file manager refuses. Reload the page and try again.
FM_INVALID_REQUEST: Part of this request was missing or invalid ({{field}}). Reload the page and try again.
FM_INVALID_PATH: That path can't be used here.
FM_INVALID_NAME: That name can't be used here.
FM_UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE: The panel didn't recognise how this request was sent. Reload the page and try again.
FM_LENGTH_REQUIRED: The upload didn't say how large it is. Try again from the Server Files page.
FM_PROFILE_NOT_FOUND: That server no longer exists. Pick another server.
FM_ROOT_UNKNOWN: That folder isn't available for this server.
FM_ROOT_UNAVAILABLE: This folder can't be opened right now.
FM_ROOT_READ_ONLY: The panel can't write to this folder. It may be mounted read-only or owned by another account.
FM_ROOT_IMMUTABLE: The top folder itself can't be renamed, moved or deleted.
FM_NOT_FOUND: That file or folder is gone. Refresh the list.
FM_NOT_A_DIRECTORY: That's a file, not a folder.
FM_NOT_A_FILE: That's a folder or a special file, not a regular file.
FM_PATH_PROTECTED: This belongs to the panel or PanelBridge and can't be changed here.
FM_LINK_ESCAPES_ROOT: This is a link to somewhere outside this folder, so it can't be opened here.
FM_OS_PERMISSION_DENIED: The panel's account isn't allowed to do this on disk ({{detail}}). Check the folder's permissions.
FM_EXISTS: Something named {{name}} is already there. Pick another name.
FM_CONFLICT: This file changed since you opened it. Reload it, then make your change again.
FM_PREVIEW_EXPIRED: The delete check expired. Select the items and try again.
FM_PREVIEW_STALE: These items changed after the delete check. Select them again.
FM_SERVER_RUNNING_BLOCKED: Stop the server before changing its world save files.
FM_OPERATION_IN_PROGRESS: Something else is working on these files right now. Try again when it finishes.
FM_FILE_IN_USE: Another program has this file open, usually the running server. Stop the server or close that program, then try again.
FM_TARGET_READ_ONLY: This file is marked read-only on disk.
FM_CROSS_DEVICE: These folders are on different drives. Download the files and upload them instead.
FM_MOVE_INTO_SELF: A folder can't be moved inside itself.
FM_TYPED_CONFIRMATION_MISMATCH: The confirmation text didn't match. Nothing was deleted.
FM_BINARY_FILE: This file isn't text, so it can't be opened in the editor. Download it instead.
FM_ENCODING_UNSUPPORTED: This file isn't UTF-8 text, so editing it here could damage it. Download it instead.
FM_FILE_TOO_LARGE_FOR_EDITOR: This file is too large to edit here. You can view its end or download it.
FM_UPLOAD_TOO_LARGE: This file is larger than the upload limit ({{limit}}).
FM_DOWNLOAD_TOO_LARGE: This file is larger than the download limit ({{limit}}).
FM_ZIP_TOO_LARGE: This selection is too large to zip. Pick fewer items, or use World Backups for a whole world.
FM_UPLOAD_SIZE_MISMATCH: The upload stopped before it finished. Nothing was saved. Try again.
FM_INSUFFICIENT_SPACE: Not enough free disk space. The panel keeps a safety margin so the server can still save.
FM_TRASH_UNAVAILABLE: These items can't be moved to Trash. You can delete them permanently instead.
FM_JOB_NOT_FOUND: That task finished or expired. Refresh the page.
FM_RATE_LIMITED: Too many file actions in a short time. Wait a moment and try again.
FM_TOO_MANY_TRANSFERS: Too many uploads or downloads are running. Wait for one to finish.
FM_SFTP_ERROR: The remote server refused this over SFTP ({{detail}}).
FM_SFTP_TIMEOUT: The remote server stopped answering over SFTP. Try again.
FM_INTERNAL: The file manager hit an unexpected error. Check the panel's log.
FM_TOO_MANY_ENTRIES: There are too many items to delete in one go (more than {{limit}}). What was already deleted stays deleted; run it again to finish.
FM_SECRET_NAME_REQUIRED: This file holds passwords the file manager keeps masked. Keep .ini in the new name so they stay masked.
DISCORD_CONFIG_CAPABILITY_REQUIRED: Changing these Discord settings would let people run bot commands that need {{detail}}, which you don't hold yourself.
HOST_NOT_ALLOWED: This panel only answers to its own addresses while panel logins are off. Open it by its IP address or localhost, or add this address under Settings > Remote Access (CORS).
SERVER_CONFIG_PATH_OUTSIDE_DATA: The server config folder must be the Server folder inside this server's Zomboid data folder, or a folder inside it. Set the Zomboid data folder first, or leave the config folder empty.
RESET_TOKEN_TOO_WEAK: The token in data/reset-token.txt could be guessed. Replace it with random hex from a generator (0-9 and a-f, as openssl rand -hex 24 writes it); words, sentences, number sequences and repeated or sequential characters are refused. Or use the recovery button on the panel host.
ZOMBOID_DATA_PATH_NOT_DATA_FOLDER: This Zomboid data folder holds files the game doesn't keep in a data folder, so the panel won't use it as a server's data folder. Choose the server's own data folder (the one with a world save in its Saves folder), an empty folder, or a folder that doesn't exist yet: the game creates it when the server first starts.
SERVER_CONSOLE_LOG_REMOTE_NOT_AVAILABLE: A remote server's console log is on its own host, so the panel can't clear it from here.
WIPE_REMOTE_NOT_AVAILABLE: A remote server's world is on its own host, so the panel can't wipe it from here.
ZOMBOID_DATA_FOLDER_REFUSED: This server's Zomboid data folder holds files the game doesn't keep in a data folder, so the panel won't list or read it. On the Servers page, edit the server and set its Zomboid Data Path to the game's own data folder: the one with a world save in its Saves folder.
SERVER_CONSOLE_LOG_NO_DATA_FOLDER: This server has no Zomboid data folder set, and the game writes its console log there. On the Servers page, edit the server and set its Zomboid Data Path.
DISCORD_CHAT_RELAY_CAPABILITY_REQUIRED: The chat relay posts what people type in its Discord channel in game, which needs {{detail}}. You don't hold it, so you can't turn the relay on or change the channel it listens in (the notification channel, while no relay channel is set).
DISCORD_CHANNEL_OUTSIDE_GUILD: The notification channel isn't in the Discord server set up here, so the bot won't post in it. Use a channel of the server whose Guild ID is set, or correct the Guild ID.
ROLE_TARGET_EXCEEDS_CALLER_CAPABILITIES: You can't change, sign out or remove an account or role that holds {{detail}}, because you don't hold it yourself.
CURRENT_PASSWORD_INCORRECT: The current password is incorrect. After 10 wrong attempts, password checks pause for 15 minutes, even with the right password.
RECOVERY_CODES_PASSWORD_REQUIRED: Enter your current password to generate recovery codes.
REFRESH_RACE: This session was just refreshed in another tab. Try again.
NETWORK_ERROR: Unable to reach the server. Check your network connection and try again.
TIMEOUT: The request timed out. Check your connection and try again.
HTTP_STATUS_400: The request was invalid. Check the provided values and try again.
HTTP_STATUS_401: Your session has expired. Sign in again and retry.
HTTP_STATUS_403: You do not have permission to perform this action.
HTTP_STATUS_404: The requested resource was not found.
HTTP_STATUS_408: The request timed out. Try again.
HTTP_STATUS_409: The request could not be completed because the data changed.
HTTP_STATUS_413: The submitted content is too large.
HTTP_STATUS_422: The server rejected the submitted values. Review the form and try again.
HTTP_STATUS_429: Too many requests were sent. Wait a moment and try again.
HTTP_5XX: The server is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.
LOGIN_FAILED: We couldn't sign you in. Check your username and password and try again.
LOGIN_CORS_BLOCKED: Connection blocked by browser origin policy. For first-time reverse-proxy setup, set CORS_ORIGINS to this URL in the panel environment and restart it. Otherwise open the panel from a local/LAN address; after setup, manage origins in Settings > Remote Access.
SETUP_FAILED: We couldn't create the admin account. Try again.
